# DMV Question Bank - Full Generative Engine Database Index

This file provides a complete, machine-readable factual database of DMV/MVD/DPS written permit tests, traffic regulations, fees, holding periods, age limits, and official motor vehicle resources for all 50 US states.

---

## Global Services & Platform Overview

- **Platform Name:** DMV Question Bank
- **Primary Domain:** https://www.dmvquestionbank.com
- **Core Functionality:** Comprehensive state-specific driver education, practice permit tests, road sign cheat sheets, mock exams, and premium test-prep revision materials updated for 2026.
- **Coverage:** All 50 US States + District of Columbia.
- **Free Access:** 20 exam-like practice questions per state with detailed rationales.
- **Premium Plan (30-Day):** $19.99 (Stripe integration, full database access, mock simulators, pass guarantee).
- **Premium Plan (90-Day):** $34.99 (Recommended for extensive study).

## State-Specific Testing and Licensing Database

### Alabama (AL)

- **Official Department Name:** Law Enforcement Agency — Driver License Division (ALEA)
- **Official Website:** https://www.alea.gov/dps/driver-license-division
- **Practice Test Hub:** https://www.dmvquestionbank.com/alabama-alea-permit-test
- **Free Practice Test URL:** https://www.dmvquestionbank.com/state/alabama/practice/free
- **Official Handbook URL:** https://www.alea.gov/dps/driver-license-division/driver-license-study-guide
- **Handbook Languages:** English

#### Written Exam Specifications
- **Teen Exam Questions:** 30
- **Adult Exam Questions:** 30
- **Passing Score (Teen):** 24 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Passing Score (Adult):** 24 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Separate Road Signs Test:** No
- **Official Practice Test Available:** No
- **Test Languages:** English
- **Online Testing From Home:** No

#### Fees, retakes, and logistics
- **Application Fee:** $36.25
- **Retake Wait Period:** 1 day
- **Maximum Allowed Attempts:** 3
- **Appointment Required:** No (Book here: https://www.alea.gov/dps/driver-license-division/driver-license-offices)
- **Official Online Permit Application:** https://www.alea.gov/dps/driver-license-division/driver-license-types/graduated-driver-license

#### Teen Licensing (GDL) Requirements
- **Minimum Age for Learner Permit:** 15
- **Parental Consent Required:** Yes
- **Permit Validity Period:** 1 year
- **Minimum Holding Period:** 6 months
- **Driver's Ed Required:** No
- **Supervised Driving Hours Required:** 30 hours total (including 10 night hours)
- **Driving Log Required:** Yes
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 21 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** 12am–6am (under 18, first 6 months with restricted license)
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** No more than 1 non-family passenger under 21 (first 6 months)
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** No handheld phone use

#### Primary Editorial Sources
- https://www.alea.gov/dps/driver-license-division/driver-license-types/graduated-driver-license
- https://www.alea.gov/dps/driver-license-division/driver-license-study-guide

- **Handbook Languages:** English

#### Written Exam Specifications
- **Teen Exam Questions:** 20
- **Adult Exam Questions:** 20
- **Passing Score (Teen):** 16 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Passing Score (Adult):** 16 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Separate Road Signs Test:** No
- **Official Practice Test Available:** No
- **Test Languages:** English
- **Online Testing From Home:** No

#### Fees, retakes, and logistics
- **Application Fee:** $15
- **Retake Wait Period:** 1 day
- **Maximum Allowed Attempts:** 3
- **Appointment Required:** No (Book here: https://doa.alaska.gov/dmv/offices/)
- **Official Online Permit Application:** https://doa.alaska.gov/dmv/akuse/teenperm.htm

#### Teen Licensing (GDL) Requirements
- **Minimum Age for Learner Permit:** 14
- **Parental Consent Required:** Yes
- **Permit Validity Period:** 2 years
- **Minimum Holding Period:** 6 months
- **Driver's Ed Required:** No
- **Supervised Driving Hours Required:** 40 hours total (including 10 night hours)
- **Driving Log Required:** Yes
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 21 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** 1am–5am (under 18)
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** No more than 1 non-family minor passenger (first 6 months)
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** No handheld phone use

#### Primary Editorial Sources
- https://doa.alaska.gov/dmv/akuse/teenperm.htm
- https://doa.alaska.gov/dmv/akuse/drivermanual.htm

#### Written Exam Specifications

- **Adult Exam Questions:** 30
- **Passing Score (Teen):** 24 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Passing Score (Adult):** 24 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Separate Road Signs Test:** No
- **Official Practice Test Available:** Yes
- **Test Languages:** English, Spanish
- **Online Testing From Home:** Yes (Permit Test @ Home available for teens with parent proctor)

#### Fees, retakes, and logistics
- **Application Fee:** $7
- **Retake Wait Period:** 1 day
- **Maximum Allowed Attempts:** 3
- **Appointment Required:** Yes (Book here: https://azmvdnow.gov/appointments)
- **Official Online Permit Application:** https://azmvdnow.gov/

#### Teen Licensing (GDL) Requirements
- **Minimum Age for Learner Permit:** 15.5
- **Parental Consent Required:** Yes
- **Permit Validity Period:** 12 months
- **Minimum Holding Period:** 6 months
- **Driver's Ed Required:** No (For ages: None (optional alternative to 30 hrs driving))
- **Supervised Driving Hours Required:** 30 hours total (including 10 night hours)
- **Driving Log Required:** No
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 21 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** Midnight-5am (first 6 months)
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** No more than 1 passenger under 18 (first 6 months, except family)
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** All cell phone use prohibited (teens)

#### Primary Editorial Sources
- https://azdot.gov/motor-vehicles/driver-services/teen-drivers/permit-and-license-requirements

- **Handbook Languages:** English, Spanish

#### Written Exam Specifications
- **Teen Exam Questions:** 25
- **Adult Exam Questions:** 25
- **Passing Score (Teen):** 20 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Passing Score (Adult):** 20 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Separate Road Signs Test:** No
- **Official Practice Test Available:** Yes
- **Test Languages:** English, Spanish
- **Online Testing From Home:** No (Must be taken in person at a DFA Revenue Office)

#### Fees, retakes, and logistics
- **Application Fee:** $40
- **Retake Wait Period:** 5 calendar days
- **Maximum Allowed Attempts:** 3 within 90 days
- **Appointment Required:** No (Book here: https://www.dfa.arkansas.gov/online-service/schedule-or-find-an-appointment/)
- **Official Online Permit Application:** https://www.dfa.arkansas.gov/office/driver-services/licenses-ids-permits/graduated-licenses/learners-and-intermediate-license/

#### Teen Licensing (GDL) Requirements
- **Minimum Age for Learner Permit:** 14
- **Parental Consent Required:** Yes
- **Permit Validity Period:** 1 year
- **Minimum Holding Period:** 6 months
- **Driver's Ed Required:** No (For ages: Not required but recommended)
- **Supervised Driving Hours Required:** 0 hours total (including 0 night hours)
- **Driving Log Required:** No
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 21 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** 11pm–4am
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** No more than 1 unrelated passenger under 21
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** All cell phone use prohibited for under 18

#### Primary Editorial Sources
- https://www.dfa.arkansas.gov/driver-services/drivers-license-faqs

- **Driving Log Required:** Yes
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 25 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** 11pm-5am (first 12 months)
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** No passengers under 20 (first 12 months)
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** No handheld phone use

### Florida (FL)

- **Official Department Name:** Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles (FLHSMV)
- **Official Website:** https://www.flhsmv.gov
- **Practice Test Hub:** https://www.dmvquestionbank.com/florida-flhsmv-permit-test
- **Free Practice Test URL:** https://www.dmvquestionbank.com/state/florida/practice/free
- **Official Handbook URL:** https://www.flhsmv.gov/driver-licenses-id-cards/motorist-handbooks-study-guides/
- **Handbook Languages:** English, Spanish, Haitian Creole

#### Written Exam Specifications
- **Teen Exam Questions:** 50
- **Adult Exam Questions:** 50
- **Passing Score (Teen):** 40 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Passing Score (Adult):** 40 correct (minimum 80%)
- **Separate Road Signs Test:** No
- **Official Practice Test Available:** No
- **Test Languages:** English, Spanish, Haitian Creole
- **Online Testing From Home:** No (Test must be taken in person at an FLHSMV office or tax collector's office)

#### Fees, retakes, and logistics
- **Application Fee:** $48
- **Retake Wait Period:** 1 day
- **Maximum Allowed Attempts:** 3 attempts per application
- **Appointment Required:** No (Book here: https://www.flhsmv.gov/offices/)
- **Official Online Permit Application:** https://www.flhsmv.gov/driver-licenses-id-cards/licenses/how-to-apply/

#### Teen Licensing (GDL) Requirements
- **Minimum Age for Learner Permit:** 15
- **Parental Consent Required:** Yes
- **Permit Validity Period:** 1 year
- **Minimum Holding Period:** 12 months
- **Driver's Ed Required:** Yes (For ages: Under 18 (TLSAE/Drug & Alcohol course required for all first-time applicants))
- **Supervised Driving Hours Required:** 50 hours total (including 10 night hours)
- **Driving Log Required:** Yes
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 21 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** 11pm–6am (first 12 months with learner's license)
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** No more than 1 non-family passenger under 18 for first 12 months
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** No cellphone use permitted while driving with a learner's license

#### Primary Editorial Sources
- https://www.flhsmv.gov/driver-licenses-id-cards/licenses/how-to-apply/
- https://www.flhsmv.gov/driver-licenses-id-cards/motorist-handbooks-study-guides/

- **Handbook Languages:** English, Spanish

#### Written Exam Specifications
- **Teen Exam Questions:** 40
- **Adult Exam Questions:** 40
- **Passing Score (Teen):** 30 correct (minimum 75%)
- **Passing Score (Adult):** 30 correct (minimum 75%)
- **Separate Road Signs Test:** No
- **Official Practice Test Available:** No
- **Test Languages:** English, Spanish, and additional languages
- **Online Testing From Home:** No (Must be taken in person at a DDS Customer Service Center)

#### Fees, retakes, and logistics
- **Application Fee:** $10
- **Retake Wait Period:** Next business day
- **Maximum Allowed Attempts:** Unlimited
- **Appointment Required:** Yes (Book here: https://online.dds.georgia.gov/Appointer/Appointment)

#### Teen Licensing (GDL) Requirements
- **Minimum Age for Learner Permit:** 15
- **Parental Consent Required:** Yes
- **Permit Validity Period:** 2 years
- **Minimum Holding Period:** 12 months (or 6 months with driver ed completion at 16+)
- **Driver's Ed Required:** Yes (For ages: Under 18 (Joshua's Law))
- **Supervised Driving Hours Required:** 40 hours total (including 6 night hours)
- **Driving Log Required:** Yes
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 21 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** Midnight-5am (Class D provisional license)
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** No more than 1 non-family passenger under 21 (first 6 months of Class D)
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** All cell phone use prohibited for Class D holders

#### Primary Editorial Sources
- https://dds.georgia.gov/getting-started-teens

- https://dds.georgia.gov/georgia-drivers-manual

- **Handbook Languages:** English, Spanish

#### Written Exam Specifications

- **Adult Exam Questions:** 40
- **Passing Score (Teen):** 34 correct (minimum 85%)
- **Passing Score (Adult):** 34 correct (minimum 85%)
- **Separate Road Signs Test:** No
- **Official Practice Test Available:** Yes
- **Test Languages:** English, Spanish
- **Online Testing From Home:** No (Must be taken in person at an ITD office)

#### Fees, retakes, and logistics
- **Application Fee:** $21.50
- **Retake Wait Period:** 3 days
- **Maximum Allowed Attempts:** Unlimited
- **Appointment Required:** No (Book here: https://itd.idaho.gov/itddmv/)
- **Official Online Permit Application:** https://itd.idaho.gov/itddmv/

#### Teen Licensing (GDL) Requirements
- **Minimum Age for Learner Permit:** 14.5
- **Parental Consent Required:** Yes
- **Permit Validity Period:** Until 18th birthday (or 180 days if 17.5+)
- **Minimum Holding Period:** 6 months
- **Driver's Ed Required:** Yes (For ages: Under 17)
- **Supervised Driving Hours Required:** 50 hours total (including 10 night hours)
- **Driving Log Required:** Yes
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 21 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** Daylight only (under 16)
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** Max 1 under 17 for first 6 months (except family)
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** No cell phone use while driving

#### Primary Editorial Sources
- https://itd.idaho.gov/itddmv/
- https://itd.idaho.gov/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/3506_gdlfactsheet.pdf
- https://itd.idaho.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/driver_manual.pdf

- **Passing Score (Adult):** 28 correct (minimum 80%)

- **Test Languages:** English, Spanish, Polish, Chinese, Korean, and others

#### Teen Licensing (GDL) Requirements
- **Minimum Age for Learner Permit:** 15
- **Parental Consent Required:** Yes
- **Permit Validity Period:** 2 years
- **Minimum Holding Period:** 9 months
- **Driver's Ed Required:** Yes (For ages: Under 17 years 3 months)
- **Supervised Driving Hours Required:** 50 hours total (including 10 night hours)
- **Driving Log Required:** Yes
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 21 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** Sun-Thu 10pm-6am, Fri-Sat 11pm-6am
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** Max 1 passenger under 20 (first 12 months, except family)
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** All cell phone use prohibited (under 19)

- **Driving Log Required:** Yes
- **Supervisor Minimum Age:** 18 years
- **GDL Nighttime Curfew:** 11pm–5am (first 6 months of restricted license)
- **GDL Passenger Restrictions:** No more than 1 non-family passenger under 18 (first 6 months)
- **GDL Cell Phone Restrictions:** No cell phone use while driving (under 18)
